subject: Re: Kickoff: dictionary learning for embedding-table compression
body:
Status + one real trade-off.

Synthetic characterization is done and matches the reference: on the documented example setup we reproduce error = 0.1128 almost exactly (0.113 on our seeds). On the production tables, results are more nuanced. Table A (entity embeddings) compresses beautifully: row_percentage=0.5, col_percentage=0.3 gives 0.14 reconstruction error and only -0.4 points recall@10 on Leilani's retrieval eval. Table B (query embeddings) is the problem child -- at the same settings error is 0.31, and we need col_percentage=0.5 and n_iterations=64 to get anywhere reasonable, which halves the sparsity win.

Trade-off to decide by end of May: ship Table A only (still ~55% of the memory savings), or spend Saoirse's remaining May sweeps chasing Table B configs.

Efe
